maximumPinTryCounter.description:
minimum: 0
maximum: 9999
The maximum amount of failed PIN tries which the cardholder can do. 
After that every PIN based transaction is declined until the PIN try counter is reset. 
No matter whether the PIN is correct or not.

nfcStatus.description:
Indicates the status of the NFC antenna. 
Possible values are:
- None (NFC antenna is not present)
- Enabled (NFC antenna is enabled)
- EnablingInProgress (Enabling of NFC antenna has been initiated but is not yet finished)
- Disabled (NFC antenna is disabled)
- DisablingInProgress (Disabling of NFC antenna has been initiated but is not yet finished)
- Locked (NFC antenna is disabled for transport but will be automatically enabled by the card once the card is used)

nfcStatusChangeCounter.description:
minimum: 0
maximum: 9999
Number of changes performed on NfcStatus. Present in case NfcStatus is present.

nfcStatusChangeTime.description:
Example: 20200518235959
Time of the last NfcStatus modification. Present in case NfcStatus is present.

offlinePinChangeStatus.description:
Examples: List [ "Pending", "InProgress", "Successful", "Failed" ]
Indicates the current status of adapting the offline PIN. 
Possible values are:
Pending (offline PIN needs to be changed but no script has been sent so far)
InProgress (at least one PIN change script has been sent; receipt of a positive or negative confirmation is outstanding)
Successful (offline PIN change finished successfully)
Failed (offline PIN change did not finish successfully)

offlinePinChangeStatusChangeTime.description:
Timestamp when the pinCheckParameterStatus was changed.
Example: 2012-12-31T22:00:00.000

offlinePinChangeTryCounter.description:
minimum: 0
maximum: 9999
Number of attempts to adapt the offline PIN, i.e. number of times a PIN change script has been sent in a response message. 
Present in case OfflinePinChangeStatus is present.

pinCheckParameter1.description:
minLength: 1
maxLength: 64
Depending on the used PIN verification method this field has different format and meaning:
- IBM 3642 algorithm: PIN offset, decimal digits
- German DK (Deutsche Kreditwirtschaft),: PRW (PIN-Referenzwert), 64 hexadecimal digits
- German Proprietary: PRW (PIN-Referenzwert), 32 hexadecimal digits
VISA: PVV, 4 decimal digits

pinCheckParameter2.description:
minLength: 1
maxLength: 64
Depending on the used PIN verification method this field has different format and meaning:
- German DK (Deutsche Kreditwirtschaft): Random value, 8 hexadecimal digits
- German Proprietary: PCC (PIN Change Counter), 4 decimal digits

pinCheckParameterStatus.description:
Examples: List [ "Active", "Blocked" ]
Status of PIN check parameters. 
Possible values are:
Active
Blocked

pinCheckParameterStatusChangeTime.description:
Timestamp when the OfflinePinChangeStatus was changed.
Example: 2012-12-31T22:00:00.000

pinTryCounter.description:
minimum: 0
maximum: 9999
Number of failed PIN entries.

pinTryCounterResetType.description:
Examples: List [ "Daily", "Fixed", "Never", "Other" ]
Indicates the algorithm to reset the PIN try counter after exceeding the maximum number of allowed wrong entries.
- Daily (Every day at a certain time)
- Fixed (After expiry of a time interval)
- Never (No automatic reset)

expiryDate.description:
The expiry date of the card
Format is MMYY

blockingReason.description: The reason why the card was blocked (if the card status is blocked)

next.description: URL pagination query parameter next page

responseDateTime.description: Timestamp when response date was generated

timeTakenMs.description: Wall clock time required from service to generate the response
